title: Topology Design for Distributed Consensus with Relay-Assisted Communication
summary: This paper focuses on relay-assisted topology optimization to accelerate the convergence of distributed consensus algorithms over weakly connected networks. Instead of permanently adding a fixed set of relay links, we introduce a time-sharing framework where multiple relay configurations are activated in a probabilistic manner. An ActiveSet-based algorithm incrementally constructs candidate relay edge sets and jointly optimizes the mixing matrices and the associated relay set activation probabilities, allowing adaptive relay selection in the optimization process.
